page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g9ae.8xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing AMD EPYC 9T95 processors running at a clock speed of 2.25 GHz. The instance is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, establishing a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 4.0 GB per core.

This instance does not include local NVMe storage or integrated GPU hardware, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 16 Gbps. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures that compute resources are not shared with other tenants, providing predictable performance for sustained workloads.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.g9ae.8xlarge offers a balanced resource profile suitable for workloads that require a steady ratio of compute power to memory without the premium cost of specialized memory-optimized or GPU-accelerated hardware. The lack of bundled local storage and GPUs keeps the baseline resource cost aligned with standard enterprise applications.

Appropriate workloads for this server configuration include medium-to-large web servers, application servers, containerized microservices, enterprise resource planning systems, and moderate database hosting where network-attached storage latency is acceptable.
